M0.1|Document primary-source visual reference study|documentation,design|P0||Extract design principles from primary sources|Ground decisions in evidence and protect originality|Steam media, browser demo, developer logs, and inspection limits|Study links sources and separates observations from inference|Manually audit links and factual claims

M0.2|Define WASL concept and fun gates|design,gameplay|P0|M0.1|Specify first action, loop, and round structure|Avoid building features on an unproven mechanic|Opportunities, stations, phases, failure, and replay|Actionable design with observable playtest gates|Paper review of the first five minutes

M0.3|Define original art bible and technical architecture|art,technical,documentation|P0|M0.1,M0.2|Choose an original identity and suitable stack|Keep production coherent and browser costs controlled|Palette, motion, audio, stack comparison, architecture|Two docs explain originality, tradeoffs, and limits|Review source links and separation from the reference

M0.4|Publish GitHub board, milestones, and dependency map|documentation,technical|P0|M0.2,M0.3|Make GitHub the source of truth|Work must not depend on chat-only planning|Board, milestones, labels, issues, README, dependency links|Each milestone has testable issues and no dependency cycle|Audit counts, links, board states, and issue metadata

M1.1|Scaffold Vite and TypeScript application|technical|P0|M0.4|Boot a small browser app|Provide one base for later features|Scripts, TypeScript config, source folders|Dev, build, and typecheck work without gameplay|Run commands and open shell in browser

M1.2|Build deterministic simulation kernel|technical,testing|P0|M1.1|Separate rules from rendering|Enable reproducible testing and tuning|Fixed tick, seeded RNG, bounded event queue|Identical seed and commands yield identical results|Vitest for determinism and queue bounds

M1.3|Build Pixi scene, grid, and camera|technical,ui-ux|P0|M1.1|Render a scalable board|All pointer actions need stable coordinates|Canvas, grid, resize, mouse-wheel zoom|Pointer aligns with cells after resize and zoom|Browser check at two sizes and Playwright smoke

M1.4|Build bilingual English and Arabic UI shell|localization,ui-ux|P0|M1.1|Support both languages from the first build|Late localization would alter the play layout|Typed strings, language switch, LTR and RTL HUD shells|Switch updates lang, dir, text, and layout without reload|Browser visual check in both languages and DOM assertions

M1.5|Set up CI and previewable shell deployment|technical,testing|P0|M1.1|Produce inspectable builds on changes|Prevent an unbootable project from accumulating|Actions for build and smoke, Pages after main succeeds|PR build succeeds and main serves a labeled shell|Inspect workflow run and deployed URL

M2.1|Implement opportunity-card mouse drag and drop|gameplay,ui-ux|P0|M1.2,M1.3,M1.4|Deliver one clear pointer action|This is the game's comprehension gateway|Drag preview, valid and invalid drop, cancel|Mouse alone completes interaction with clear feedback|Playwright pointer path and browser cancel check

M2.2|Implement workstation placement and relocation|gameplay,ui-ux|P0|M2.1|Make layout an actual decision|Position must affect outcome visibly|Prototype purchase, place, move, connection preview|Preview explains position and prevents overlap|Cell-rule tests and browser drag check

M2.3|Process one opportunity and award its return|gameplay,technical|P0|M2.1,M2.2|Complete the smallest causal cycle|Prove the first action has value|Entry, processing, exit, one payout event|One opportunity delivers and pays exactly once|Vitest state path and Playwright mouse flow

M2.4|Show first referral as a visible chain|gameplay,art|P0|M2.3|Make cascading payoff legible|A counter alone misses the desired feel|One bounded referral, pulse, animated connection|Player can trace referral source and destination|Chain-bound test and visual review

M2.5|Playtest the prototype fun gate|design,testing|P0|M2.4|Make a go or revise decision before upgrades|The first mechanic may not yet be fun|Short observed sessions and bottleneck report|Record first-10-second understanding and layout decisions|Document playtests and open repair issue if gate fails

M3.1|Add runway economy and operating costs|gameplay,technical|P0|M2.5|Create investment tradeoffs|Purchases need an opportunity cost|Income, pricing, and configurable operating cost|No unintended negative values; balance changes are explained|Vitest edge cases and HUD check

M3.2|Add opportunity deadlines and telegraphed market pressure|gameplay,ui-ux|P0|M3.1|Force timely choices|No pressure would make the round passive|Clear timers and an initial market wave|Warning precedes pressure and missed opportunity has a reason|Deterministic timing test and visual check

M3.3|Implement round win and failure conditions|gameplay,testing|P0|M3.2|Give the run a clear ending|Progress needs an explicit goal|Impact target, cash failure, recovery window|Only one ending triggers and shows a specific cause|Vitest states and Playwright for both endings

M3.4|Build results screen and mouse-only retry|gameplay,ui-ux|P0|M3.3|Support one-more-run replay|Players need to know what to improve|Best chain, bottleneck, retry action|Second run begins without stale state or keyboard input|Playwright two consecutive runs

M3.5|Persist settings, language, and initial unlocks|technical,testing,localization|P1|M3.4|Make browser sessions recover safely|Tabs close and language choice should remain|Versioned save, locale, audio, initial unlock|Reload keeps settings without duplicate rewards|Vitest migration and browser reload in both locales

M3.6|Publish first playable round|technical,testing,high-priority|P0|M3.4,M3.5,M1.5|Provide a stable trial URL|Always-playable builds are a project goal|Full mouse smoke, bilingual check, README URL|Main serves one complete round in both languages|Actions, Playwright, and manual browser review

M4.1|Define data-driven upgrades and readable tree|gameplay,ui-ux|P0|M3.6|Make upgrade choices scalable|Hard-coded branches slow balance iteration|Schema, prerequisites, branch view|Available and locked nodes explain their state|Vitest unlock rules and bilingual UI check

M4.2|Implement visible Product upgrade branch|gameplay,art|P1|M4.1|Create a quality and throughput specialization|Establish the first viable build|Three or four upgrades changing station behavior or form|Each upgrade changes a measured outcome and visible behavior|Seeded before/after test and visual review

M4.3|Implement Growth and referral upgrade branch|gameplay,art|P1|M4.1|Create a referral-focused specialization|Offer a competing strategy|Three or four referral and channel upgrades|Chains are bounded, readable, and correctly valued|Vitest chain bounds and playtest

M4.4|Implement Operations and routing upgrade branch|gameplay,technical|P1|M4.1|Create a capacity and cost specialization|Prepare later automation|Three or four sorting and capacity upgrades|Backlog pressure changes visibly and numerically|Queue tests and browser check

M4.5|Implement workstation adjacency synergies|gameplay,design|P0|M4.2,M4.3|Make placement central to strategy|Otherwise the board is decorative|Two initial neighbor bonuses and clear cues|Moving a station changes output and explains why|Adjacency tests and before/after screenshots

M4.6|Implement placeable automatic dispatcher|gameplay,technical|P0|M4.4,M4.5|Reduce repetitive dragging|Escalation should shift toward system building|Capacity-limited dispatcher and route preview|Operates without repeated clicks but allows manual intervention|Vitest routing and mouse-only Playwright

M4.7|Balance two builds and cap referral cascades|design,testing,performance|P0|M4.3,M4.5,M4.6|Avoid a single dominant build or event explosion|Synergies can break economy and performance|Two fixed-seed scenarios and playtest report|Two builds can win; no unbounded loop|Stress test and documented playtest

M5.1|Add Team and Network phase content|gameplay,design|P1|M4.7|Expand after the core loop works|Escalation needs new problems to solve|Limited opportunity and station types per phase|Each tool addresses pressure introduced earlier|Browser runs in both phases and pacing report

M5.2|Add City finale and campaign ending|gameplay,design|P1|M5.1|Complete an escalation arc|Players need an ending instead of endless grind|Final target, pressure wave, ending screen|Campaign can finish without softlock|Full-path test and failure seed

M5.3|Create original core art pack|art,performance|P1|M4.7|Unify visual identity|Inconsistent art harms readability|Station, card, background forms and atlas|Assets follow art bible and have documented sources|Visual review and asset-size check

M5.4|Add staged motion, effects, and original audio|art,audio,performance|P1|M5.3,M5.1|Strengthen causal game feel|Feedback matters more than feature count|Pulses, paths, original cues, mute|Effects explain events without obscuring UI or stacking sound|Audio/visual check and VFX cap test

M5.5|Playtest phase readability and bilingual accessibility|ui-ux,localization,testing|P0|M5.2,M5.4|Keep escalation understandable|Dense scenes can hide decisions|Shape/color cues, translated copy, layout at sizes|New players explain chains and goals in both languages|Playtest and English/Arabic browser QA

M6.1|Profile and optimize FPS and event density|performance,technical|P0|M5.5|Protect final-phase performance|Automation can overload CPU and GPU|Profiling, entity/VFX budgets, batching|At least 30fps on test laptop at peak or documented exception|Recorded profile and stress scene

M6.2|Measure and optimize initial download size|performance|P1|M5.3,M6.1|Make the browser start quickly|Large bundles lose players before gameplay|Atlas, staged loading, compression|Target 2MB compressed or document measured exception|Bundle analysis and browser network trace

M6.3|Verify save recovery and corrupted-data behavior|technical,testing|P0|M5.2,M3.5|Prevent progress loss or invalid state|Save schema evolves with content|Migration, corruption, and update scenarios|No crash or duplicated reward from an old save|Vitest and browser reload

M6.4|Test desktop browsers, pointer input, and both directions|testing,localization|P0|M6.1,M6.3|Keep the full game stable on desktop|WebGL, pointers, and fonts vary|Chrome, Edge, Firefox, two window sizes, both locales|Core path works; deviations have linked issues|Browser smoke matrix

M6.5|Review Alpha balance and priority defects|design,bug,testing|P0|M6.2,M6.4|Make an evidence-based Alpha gate|Release requires known risks|Playtest, defect triage, pacing update|No open P0 and measured fun gates|Alpha report and linked issues

M7.1|Run a small external Beta playtest|design,testing|P0|M6.5|Validate comprehension outside the team|Familiarity hides onboarding problems|New-player sessions and structured notes|Major blockers have prioritized issues|Session report and evidence as needed

M7.2|Fix Beta blockers and tune economy|gameplay,bug|P0|M7.1|Deliver fair, legible rounds|Test findings must drive changes|P0/P1 fixes and bounded balance changes|No softlock or unexplained dominant build|Regression tests and playtest

M7.3|Proofread English and Arabic UI and layouts|localization,ui-ux|P1|M7.2|Make both languages natural and readable|Copy is part of rapid comprehension|Terms, numbers, fonts, tooltips, buttons|No clipped text or wrong direction through full flow|Visual check at three sizes in both locales

M7.4|Stabilize production release and deployment|technical,testing|P0|M7.2,M7.3|Provide a permanent current build|A playable URL is the delivery promise|Release Actions, Pages, versioning, rollback|URL serves tested main build with green smoke|Fresh-browser check and workflow review

M7.5|Update README, play guide, and release gate|documentation,testing|P0|M7.4|Hand over a clear, maintainable release|Users need the current state and entry point|README, changelog, links, limitations|Play URL, version, and known limits are accurate|Link audit and release checklist
